ANKIT SABINKAR

+91-8867701487 | ankitaurora@gmail.com | Hyderabad, India

LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/ankit-sabinkar

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Data Engineering Leader with 14+ years in IT and 7+ years specializing in data platform architecture. Architected and delivered end-to-end data warehouse solutions processing 10,000+ assets daily across Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, and Azure. Led dbt adoption for 40+ engineers with CI/CD automation, reducing deployment errors by 80%. Designed medallion architectures with SCD Type 2 modeling, row-level security, and dynamic data masking for regulated industries. Experienced across HR Analytics, Manufacturing, Digital Asset Management, and Financial Services domains with global stakeholder collaboration.

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS

Architected dbt infrastructure adopted by 40+ engineers as the standard transformation layer, with CI/CD, coding standards, and comprehensive documentation

Designed 5-stage serverless pipeline processing 10,000+ digital assets daily with 99.9% uptime and zero data loss over 12 months

Recovered production SCD Type 2 data after accidental full refresh using Snowflake Time Travel with zero data loss within 1 hour

Migrated 200+ Informatica PowerCenter workflows to Snowflake/dbt with automated reconciliation framework validating transformation accuracy

Reduced dbt build times by 60% through slim CI with state:modified selectors and incremental modeling strategies

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Data Platforms: Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift, BigQuery

Transformation & Modeling: dbt (Core & Cloud), Medallion Architecture, SCD Type 2, Dimensional Modeling, Fivetran

Languages: SQL, Python, PySpark, SparkSQL, Unix Shell Scripting

AWS: S3, Glue, Lambda, Redshift, Athena, DynamoDB, CloudWatch, CloudFormation, Secrets Manager, Step Functions, SNS, SQS, EC2, RDS, DataSync, VPC

Azure: Databricks, DevOps (CI/CD pipelines)

GCP: BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, Cloud Composer

Orchestration: Apache Airflow, MWAA, Astronomer, Autosys

Data Governance: Collibra, Row-Level Security, Dynamic Data Masking, RBAC

DevOps & Tools: GitHub, Git, Jira, VS Code, Notion, CI/CD Pipelines

Databases: Oracle, MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, DB2

DOMAIN EXPERTISE

HR / People Analytics (SuccessFactors, Talent Acquisition, Employee Lifecycle) | Manufacturing (ERP Systems, Legacy Migration) | Digital Asset Management (AEM, Salesforce Data Cloud) | Financial Services (Investment Banking, Equities Research) | Customer Master Data Management

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Lead Data Engineer, Data Engineering | AuxoAI	   Dec 2024 – Present

OURA — Enterprise Bulk Order Data Platform (May 2026 – Present)

Architecting a unified data platform integrating CRM, CPQ, contracts, fulfillment, and ERP systems to enable end-to-end order tracking and revenue reconciliation for OURA's enterprise bulk order business (corporate wellness and insurance partners).

Designing integration architecture connecting HubSpot (CRM), DealHub (CPQ), Ironclad (contract management), Bulk Order Portal (fulfillment), and NetSuite (ERP/revenue recognition) into a unified analytical platform on Snowflake

Building end-to-end order tracking models that follow each enterprise deal from sales opportunity through quote, contract, customer-driven fulfillment data, and final revenue recognition in NetSuite

Developing revenue reconciliation framework comparing NetSuite revenue postings against originating contracts and deals to surface discrepancies before financial close

Modeling deal lifecycle stages across heterogeneous source systems (HubSpot pipeline, DealHub quote states, Ironclad contract status, NetSuite order states) into a unified state machine for cross-functional reporting

Implementing dbt-based transformation layer on Snowflake with source-aligned staging, conformed dimensions, and incremental marts powering operations and finance dashboards

Manufacturing Domain — Legacy Migration (DB2/Informatica to Snowflake)

Migrated 200+ legacy ETL workflows from DB2/Informatica PowerCenter to Snowflake + dbt, with Fivetran for automated source synchronization.

Converted Informatica PowerCenter XML-based workflow mappings to dbt SQL models, mapping each transformation type (Expression, Joiner, Lookup, Aggregator, Router, SCD) to its SQL equivalent

Configured Fivetran source connectors with CDC to sync data from DB2 into Snowflake, eliminating manual extraction processes

Built automated reconciliation framework comparing row counts, key aggregates, and hash checks between legacy and dbt outputs, catching discrepancies before UAT

Leveraged AI-assisted code generation to accelerate conversion of straightforward mappings, allowing team to focus on complex transformation validation

Ventura Foods — People Analytics Data Warehouse

Architected a People Analytics warehouse for ~11,000 employees on Snowflake + dbt, integrating SuccessFactors via Fivetran.

Designed Bronze/Silver/Gold medallion architecture processing employee lifecycle, talent acquisition, and workforce planning data

Implemented SCD Type 2 dimension models with hash-based change detection, tracking employee promotions, transfers, and title changes over time

Set up dbt CI/CD pipeline with GitHub PR validation using state:modified selectors, reducing build times by 60%

Implemented row-level security (business unit isolation) and dynamic data masking (salary, SSN, PII) across Snowflake

Recovered production SCD2 data after accidental full refresh using Snowflake Time Travel (CREATE TABLE CLONE AT), ensuring zero data loss within 1 hour

Resolved Iceberg table metadata staleness issues with Fivetran integration by adjusting catalog refresh intervals

ADI — dbt Infrastructure & Adoption (40+ Engineers)

Built dbt infrastructure from scratch and drove organization-wide adoption across 40+ engineers.

Designed project structure (staging/intermediate/marts), source configurations, directory layout, and multi-environment setup

Configured slim CI pipelines per environment using state:modified selectors, enabling targeted PR validation and reducing CI run times

Integrated Snowflake using key-pair authentication per environment for secure, passwordless connectivity

Developed reusable macros (surrogate keys, audit columns, incremental helpers) reducing boilerplate by 40% across teams

Authored comprehensive Confluence documentation covering incremental models, snapshots, deferral strategies, and dbt contracts with real-world examples

Defined coding standards and naming conventions; trained and onboarded 40+ engineers on dbt workflows and best practices

Lead Data Engineer | Genpact (Enquero)	Dec 2021 – Dec 2024

AEM Digital Assets Pipeline — Salesforce Data Cloud

Designed and built a 5-stage serverless data ingestion pipeline processing digital assets from Adobe Experience Manager into Salesforce Data Cloud.

Architected end-to-end pipeline (get, load, transform, deactivate, export) orchestrated by Airflow on Astronomer, executed via AWS Lambda

Designed security classification engine categorizing assets into distinct S3 tiers (Partners, PTAC, Distributors, Public) using path-based rules and metadata analysis

Engineered date-range chunking (30-day windows) and batch processing (25 assets/batch) to handle large-scale AEM queries within Lambda timeout constraints

Implemented dynamic task mapping with expand_kwargs for parallel processing across 4 content types, with TaskGroups for logical grouping

Built database-driven configuration model — adding new pipeline objects required only a SQL INSERT, zero code deployment

Identified and resolved silent Lambda failures by implementing explicit FunctionError checking in Airflow DAG, preventing false-positive task successes

Led UAT deployment including CloudFormation stack configuration, AWS Secrets Manager integration, and cross-account troubleshooting

FluidTopics-to-DataCloud Pipeline

Built automated ingestion pipeline on the Enterprise Data Platform for enterprise content discovery and access control.

Architected pipeline using AWS Lambda, S3 (L1/L2 pattern), Airflow, and Athena following the AEM reference architecture

Implemented cumulative security-level duplication model with composite metadata keys for referential integrity across access tiers

Built MySQL-backed metadata layer for incremental processing, offset tracking, and export orchestration

Externalized security hierarchy into deployable JSON artifact, decoupling business rules from pipeline logic

Heineken — Harmonized Data Pipelines (HDP)

Designed ETL pipelines harmonizing ERP data from multiple global locations for a leading brewery on Azure Databricks + dbt.

Harmonized ERP data from multiple regional schemas into one unified analytical model, enabling consistent cross-region reporting

Implemented incremental modeling strategies in dbt, reducing pipeline run times from 30+ minutes to 3-5 minutes on large ERP tables

Built reusable macros and managed dbt contracts/versions to protect downstream consumers from breaking schema changes

Set up CI/CD through Azure DevOps — PR-triggered slim CI against UAT, merge-to-main deployed to production automatically

Utilized Collibra for data governance and business terminology standardization across global teams

Collaborated with global stakeholders in Amsterdam for on-site data mapping requirements gathering

Optimized long-running Databricks jobs through OPTIMIZE, ZORDER, and cluster sizing recommendations

Data Engineer | Cognizant	Jun 2014 – Dec 2021

Investment Bank — AWS ETL Pipeline (Dec 2018 – Dec 2021)

Designed and built ETL pipelines for equities and trading data on AWS using Glue, PySpark, and DynamoDB.

Built PySpark transformations in AWS Glue processing multi-region trading data (AEJ, EMEA, US) with currency exchange rate joins and null handling

Leveraged DynamoDB to store ETL configuration and business logic as dynamic content, enabling rule changes without code redeployment

Automated file arrival from remote Unix machines to EC2/S3 using Unix scripting and DataSync

Validated ETL logic in Athena and built data quality scripts comparing legacy and new system outputs using statistical analysis

Monitored pipeline health using CloudWatch; orchestrated file arrival processes using Autosys

Europe Investment Bank — Database Development (Jun 2014 – Dec 2018)

Designed databases for Equities Quantitative Research linking data from Worldscope, Reuters, Factset, and Bloomberg.

Developed stored procedures for data access and loading across multiple financial data providers

Automated client reporting by connecting Excel with Oracle Database using ODBC

Senior Business Analyst | Altisource Business Solutions	Feb 2012 – Jun 2014

Provided business analysis for Mortgage Banking applications; validated claims data using SQL

CERTIFICATIONS

dbt Certified Analytics Engineer — dbt Labs | May 2026

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Technology — Computer Science and Information Technology

Aurora's Engineering College, JNTU Hyderabad | 2011
